newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: In a drill, dogs find explosives at APEC venue.
newsitem.headline: In a drill, dogs find explosives at APEC venue.

text.p: Bomb-sniffing dogs on Wednesday found explosives in a building at Subic Bay in the Philippines where world leaders will meet at an APEC summit next week, but officials said it was just a drill.
Dozens of people evacuated the building near the gates of Subic Bay freeport four hours drive from Manila after an anonymous caller said a bomb had been planted there.

But Subic Bay Metropolitian Authority Chairman Richard Gordon told Reuters it was just a drill to test how quickly security forces would respond to an emergency and how well the dogs could detect explosives.
The explosives were packed into a pipe bomb.
"It's a drill... part of the whole she-bang so that we would be able to test the capacity of our canine dogs," he said by telephone. "It's a field training exercise."

Among leaders of the 18 APEC members at the summit, to be hosted by Philippine President Fidel Ramos, will be U.S. President Bill Clinton, Indonesian President Suharto and Chinese President Jiang Zemin.
